bullets.text: NLC India plans a 1,080 MW (4 x 270 MW) coal-based power JV to meet NALCO's expansion power needs; land is available with NALCO.
bullets.source: Elara - NLC India – Q2FY27 Investor Meeting KTA

detail.summary: The NALCO JV is one of four thermal projects NLC lists as under consideration in its corporate plan to 2032. No award date or cost is given for it, and management says thermal projects generally take four to six years to complete.
points: 1,080 MW, 4 x 270 MW, coal-based
Purpose: NALCO's expansion-related power requirements
Land available with NALCO
Thermal projects take around 4-6 years to complete

bullets.text: NLC says its coal realisations rose from about Rs1,500-1,800/t to nearly Rs2,800/t over the previous year and expects prices to normalise as eastern output recovers.
bullets.source: Elara - NLC India – Q2FY27 Investor Meeting KTA

detail.summary: Management ties the firm coal prices to lower production in eastern India from monsoon disruption and expects a gradual normalisation. Talabira is its only mine at full scale, with part of the output sold through government entities and e-auctions.
points: Realisation about Rs1,500-1,800/t to nearly Rs2,800/t
Talabira dispatch 10.12 MT in H1FY27, up 15% YoY
About 3.5 MT supplied to NTPC, balance via government entities and e-auction
Pachwara South evacuation from Feb-Mar 2027, about 9 MT in 2-3 years
Ghatampur gets 3-4 coal rakes a day against 7-7.5 needed

bullets.text: LME copper fell 8% and aluminium 3% week on week in rupees; Voltas signed a JV with Atomberg for room AC compressors, taking 50%.
bullets.source: Kotak - India durables/electricals: Weekly wrap on news flow, weather patterns, and valuations

detail.summary: The weekly wrap shows input costs easing over the week but still far above last year, with Kotak's theoretical raw-material indices for durables up sharply. News flow points to post-Diwali price hikes across phones, TVs and refrigerators.
points: Copper / aluminium / domestic HRC: -8% / -3% / flat WoW
Same three: +24% / +15% / +38% YoY
RM indices for RAC, washers, refrigerators, fans up 29-57% YoY
Week's gainers: Blue Star +12.8%, Voltas +9%, Crompton +5.7%
Laggards: RR Kabel -8.7%, KEI -5.2%, TTK Prestige -4.7%

bullets.text: NLC India's board approved a plan to 2032: thermal 6.6 GW to 14.9 GW and renewables 1.8 GW to 16.2 GW, on about Rs1,600bn of capex.
bullets.source: Elara - NLC India – Q2FY27 Investor Meeting KTA

detail.summary: The meeting notes pair a large expansion plan with near-term drag from under-recoveries, which management expects to stay elevated in FY27 and fall substantially from FY28. About 600 MW of renewable capacity is ready but waiting on transmission lines.
points: Mining capacity 50 MTPA to 122 MTPA by 2032
H1FY27 thermal generation 14.62 BU, up 19% YoY
Neyveli TPS-II Expansion 2,500 MW, award targeted this financial year
Ghatampur under-recoveries about Rs4.9bn as of September
About 950 MW renewable additions by end FY27, about 2 GW a year from FY28

bullets.text: Kotak Midcap Conference schedule: Nuvoco and Inox Wind on Thu 26 Nov, JSW Cement and KPIT on Fri 27 Nov, Grand Hyatt Mumbai.

detail.summary: The delegate schedule lists four in-person meetings over two days at the Grand Hyatt, Kalina. Two are one-on-ones and two are group meetings.
points: Thu 26 Nov 15:00-16:00: Nuvoco Vistas, group
Thu 26 Nov 16:00-17:00: Inox Wind, 1x1
Fri 27 Nov 11:00-12:00: JSW Cement, small group, CFO attending
Fri 27 Nov 13:00-14:00: KPIT Technologies, 1x1
